purpose: Run the admitted COMMERCIAL_NONFICTION_5X8_BW fast path for a compatible book without repeating donor, renderer, typography, front-matter or TOC exploration.

required_inputs.name: approved_bookspec
required_inputs.description: BookSpec approved for the target title and format set.

required_inputs.name: approved_manuscript
required_inputs.description: Production-ready manuscript with no open P0/P1 factual blockers.

required_inputs.name: source_registry
required_inputs.description: Normalized source registry resolving all reader-facing citations and endnotes.

required_inputs.name: production_profile
required_inputs.description: Admitted commercial nonfiction profile compatible with the requested book and formats.

required_inputs.name: cover_direction
required_inputs.description: Approved cover direction or a request to produce three bounded concepts.

deterministic_steps.description: Confirm approved BookSpec/manuscript, compatibility with the admitted profile, source state and target formats; fail closed on exceptions.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: admitted profile selected and preflight PASS

deterministic_steps.description: Resolve reader-facing sources and notes through the existing normalized source contract.
Use the approved cover direction; stop for a bounded human visual decision if none exists.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: approved cover reference or human gate

deterministic_steps.description: Produce representative interior proof surfaces only when the book exposes a profile exception; otherwise reuse admitted geometry and typography.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: profile reuse confirmed or bounded human visual gate

deterministic_steps.description: Build paperback and Kindle Create input through the admitted toolchain without manual page-specific fixes.
Run format geometry, TOC, pagination, page balance, hyphenation, links, source leakage and Kindle print-leakage checks.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: technical QA PASS without claiming visual acceptance

deterministic_steps.description: Confirm every paperback page is present in the contact sheet and no suspicious page escapes review.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: complete contact sheet and machine-readable QA

deterministic_steps.description: Human approves the full contact sheet, final artifacts and publication handoff; technical QA alone cannot close this gate.

QUICK: no reader-facing proof residue in rendered text
STANDARD: preflight contract PASS or explicit proof gate
FULL: EPUB/Kindle preview QA where tooling is available
CRITICAL: KDP or external publication gate with supervised human approval

escalate_to_full_on: format output intended for publication rather than proof

expected_outputs: cover concept or approved cover record
compact evidence for profile admission or rejection
prohibited_changes: new renderer framework without donor comparison
manual page-specific patches as production method
donor audit for a compatible admitted-profile book
renderer, typography, front-matter or TOC design exploration without a detected exception
interior visuals enabled without explicit admission
treating technical build success as visual approval
decorative visuals without source or explanatory value
escalation_conditions: profile not admitted and human visual proof unavailable
cover concept illegible at thumbnail size
unresolved rights or publication account boundary
new paid or external production service required
